parts.gloss: those who are deeply in love

literal: With modesty, good manliness, formerly I possessed; today I possess, those who are in love ride, the palmyra horse.
translation: In the past, I possessed modesty and noble self-control; today, all I possess is the palmyra horse that those consumed by love ride.
modern: முன்பு நான் நாணத்தையும் நல்ல ஆண்மையையும் (மனவலிமையையும்) பெற்றிருந்தேன்; ஆனால் இன்று, காதலில் வருந்துவோர் ஏறும் மடல் குதிரையை மட்டுமே நான் பெற்றுள்ளேன்.
explanation: The hero, suffering from the intense pain of separation and unfulfilled love, speaks of his desperate state. In the past, he was guided by modesty (நாண்) and strong self-control or manliness (ஆண்மை). However, the overwhelming power of his love has stripped him of these virtues. Now, his only possession and recourse is the 'madal' (மடல்)—a horse made of sharp palmyra stems, which disappointed lovers traditionally ride publicly to proclaim their love and seek sympathy.
